svg.aria-label: What ships with bkit, one coloured row per phase. Design: independent review, three rival designs, runs on any AI tool, your sign-off. Plan: five reviewers, scope kept tight, 35 audits, best model per job. Build: writes and verifies, hunts bugs and security holes, quality checks, parallel features. Debug: self-fixing builds, root cause first, honest CI, context fetch. Ship: nothing quietly dropped, docs and memory, skills on demand, laptop to cloud.
